---
title: "Solana about page centres the image when stacked"
image: https://quarto.org/quarto.png
about:
  id: about-15178
  template: solana
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['div.quarto-about-solana img.about-image']
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        - ['div\.quarto-about-solana \.about-entity\s*\{[^}]*align-items:\s*start']
        - ['div\.quarto-about-solana \.about-entity\s*\{[^}]*align-items:\s*center[\s\S]*div\.quarto-about-solana \.about-entity\s*\{[^}]*align-items:\s*start']
---

::: {#about-15178}

Below the `lg` breakpoint the layout stacks, and the image must be centred
like the text. The base `align-items: start` must come before the
breakpoint rule, so it can't override it.

:::
